Once I have the list, I need to calculate the total maximum expense. Assuming 2 meals per day, which is 10 meals total. If each meal is, say, €20, that's €200. Adding the cost of car rental, restaurants, and hotels, I can sum it up. 

I should make sure to apply the offer with the highest quality score first, as per the instructions. So, if there are multiple offers, I pick the one with the highest quality, which in this case is 95.
